summary: Durable equipment and depth progression for the shared Dawnmine. Every material has a repeatable bounded source and a sink; every upgrade names the earlier-depth problem it solves and the different deeper problem it does not solve. Pack claims cite M0 audit artifacts or pinned-JAR recipe/loot resources.

sinks.ref: Furnace and blast-furnace fuel for the smelting/forging chains below (vanilla mechanic).

materials.boundedYield: 5 upper resource fields x up to 2 veins x vein cap 3: at most 30 coal ore blocks per run even if every field rolled coal (combined weight 8 of 33 upper resource weight; typical far lower).
evidence: overgeared-1.21.1-1.6.17.jar data/overgeared/recipe/crude_steel_from_alloying.json (3 iron ingot + 1 coal -> 4 crude steel)

sinks.ref: Copper ingots feed Create machinery work and magistuarmory copper-tier gear (e.g. magistuarmory:copper_kiteshield, verified in M0 candidate index).

materials.boundedYield: Same upper-field bound as coal: at most 30 copper ore blocks per run (combined weight 8 of 33).
evidence: M0-recipe-equipment-candidates.csv.gz: magistuarmory:copper_* equipment rows verified present

sinks.ref: Smelt to iron_ingot, blast to steel via magistuarmory:furnace/steel_ingot_blasting, or forge vanilla iron gear — e.g. overgearedspartan:iron/weapons/pickaxe produces minecraft:iron_pickaxe (vanilla recipe id disabled by the pack overlay).

materials.boundedYield: At most 30 iron ore blocks per run (5 upper fields x 2 veins x vein cap 3, combined weight 8 of 33), plus the bounded upper combat bonus: 20% over at most 8 alive tracked hostiles (~1.6 raw iron expected per run).
evidence: data/dawnmine/ore_catalog/standard.json (iron ores verified iron-pickaxe minimum by M3 player-break audit)

sinks.ref: Butchery pack recipes (utility material); no progression gate depends on it.

evidence: M0-ore-candidates.csv: sulfur_ore loot table verified to drop butchery:sulfur

sinks.ref: FungiDelight food-chain input (utility); keeps early runs worthwhile for non-combat players.

evidence: M0-ore-candidates.csv: truffle_dirt resolves fungidelight:truffle_ore tag and drops fungidelight:truffle

evidence: data/dawnmine/ore_catalog/standard.json (nether_gold_ore native drop is minecraft:gold_nugget, wooden-pickaxe minimum)

At most 14 dark metal deposit blocks per run (vein cap 1, weight 1 of 13); non-silk-touch drops 4-7 pieces per verified loot table.

Out-of-mine by design: the deepest tool gate asks for overworld preparation between runs.

sources.ref: Vanilla Nether bastion remnant chests (vanilla loot behavior; pack overlay not separately verified — flagged as an open uncertainty).

materials.boundedYield: Bastion-hunt bound only; no mine source.
evidence: Vanilla Minecraft bastion loot (unverified against pack overlays; recorded as an uncertainty rather than a pack claim)

upgrades.solves: Upper iron and zinc ore require an iron-tier pick (ore-catalog minimum verified by M3 player-break tests); without one a run can only work coal, copper, sulfur, truffle and stone-tool nodes, so a first visit is useful but iron-poor.
upgrades.doesNotSolve: Does not harvest anything deeper than iron tier — ancient debris still refuses it and infected diamond ores trigger their termite summon regardless of tool; it also gives no combat answer to decrepit_skeleton pursuit while mining.
evidence: overgearedspartan-0.68-neo.jar recipe/iron/weapons/pickaxe.json (handle + iron_pickaxe_head — runtime id verified by RecipeManager sweep; vanilla minecraft:iron_pickaxe id disabled by neoforge:false overlay)

inputs: overgeared_epic_knights:steel_shortsword_blade x1 (forged on the anvil from steel; steel via magistuarmory:furnace/steel_ingot_blasting or overgeared crude-steel alloying)
upgrades.solves: Upper-tier decrepit_skeleton pursuit wears out starter weapons across a full push; runtime-verified steel durability (longsword class 1000 vs iron 600 in the M0 startup log) lets one sidearm survive into middle depth.
upgrades.doesNotSolve: Middle bone_imp armored pairs still force target focus and kiting around junctions; the sword adds no armor, no harvest tier, and no answer to being cornered.
evidence: overgeared_epic_knights-1.21.1-1.1.0.jar recipe/crafting/shortsword/steel_shortsword.json (blade + hilt — runtime id verified by RecipeManager sweep; the magistuarmory: vanilla-style id is shadowed)
M0-recipe-equipment-audit.md: runtime durability log silver 350 / iron 600 / steel 1000 / diamond 2000 (longsword class)

inputs: overgeared:steel_pickaxe_head x1 (forged from overgeared:heated_steel_ingot; steel via magistuarmory blasting or overgeared crude-steel alloying)
upgrades.solves: Middle fields (silver, gold, redstone, lapis, gems, seabrass) all cap at iron tier; a steel pick survives a full middle mining route where an iron pick wears out.
upgrades.doesNotSolve: Still cannot harvest ancient_debris — the verified chaos-tier tool gate is unchanged — and it does nothing for middle melee pressure.
evidence: overgearedspartan-0.68-neo.jar recipe/steel/weapons/pickaxe.json (handle + steel_pickaxe_head — runtime id verified by RecipeManager sweep; overgeared:steel_pickaxe id disabled by neoforge:false overlay)

upgrades.solves: Middle melee pairs (bone_imp + pursuer) punish standing still while mining; a shield lets a player guard while backing out to a wider junction instead of dying in a dead end.
upgrades.doesNotSolve: A guard does not move the player — the chaos 3-imp surge still breaks a static defense, and the shield does not protect a teammate across the room.
evidence: overgeared_epic_knights-1.21.1-1.1.0.jar data/overgeared_epic_knights/recipe/forging/kiteshield/steel_kiteshield.json (overgeared:forging: 2 steel plates around a wood_kiteshield — runtime recipe id verified by RecipeManager sweep)

upgrades.solves: Silver ore is stone-tool accessible and also a middle combat bonus, so a team short on iron can still field a dedicated weapon; the pack ships a full silver gear line for any creature with a silver weakness.
upgrades.doesNotSolve: M0 could not verify which configured mine mob is silver-weak, so it is not a proven counter to decrepit_skeleton, bone_imp, or the diamond termite; silver durability (350-420 class) is below steel and does not replace it.
evidence: overgeared_epic_knights-1.21.1-1.1.0.jar data/overgeared_epic_knights/recipe/crafting/shortsword/silver_shortsword.json (blade + hilt — runtime recipe id verified by RecipeManager sweep)
M0-recipe-equipment-audit.md: 'the pack recipe data does not prove which Born in Chaos mobs require silver damage'

inputs: overgeared:diamond_upgrade_smithing_template x1 (overworld structure chests ~15%, then 1 -> 2 duplication recipe)
upgrades.solves: The only catalog node gated behind a diamond tool — ancient_debris — becomes harvestable, opening the netherite chain; this is the verified depth key of the economy.
upgrades.doesNotSolve: The chaos 3-imp surge still demands a coordinated group, Chaos Depths lava/quartz hazards are unchanged, and wherever infected ore appears its break summons a diamond-termite ambush (verified procedure; placement is a blocked node below); the tool opens the door, it does not clear the room.
evidence: M0-native-loot-smoke.md: infected ore onDestroyedByPlayer summons the termite

inputs: magistuarmory:steel_kiteshield x1 (the middle-tier shield wall — forged from 2 steel plates on a wood_kiteshield)
overgeared:diamond_upgrade_smithing_template x1 (overworld structure chests ~15%, then 1 -> 2 duplication recipe)
upgrades.solves: The same banked template that upgrades the pick also reforges the middle-tier shield wall into diamond-class durability — a second use for a scarce exploration find that hardens the front-line for a chaos breach.
upgrades.doesNotSolve: Consumes both the scarce template and a full steel kiteshield; raises no harvest tier and deals no damage, so a guarded player still cannot hold the 3-imp surge alone and still eats the termite ambush on infected-ore breaks.
evidence: overgeared_epic_knights-1.21.1-1.1.0.jar recipe/smithing/steel_kiteshield_to_diamond_kiteshield.json (steel_kiteshield + diamond + template — runtime id verified by RecipeManager sweep; direct magistuarmory id shadowed)

upgrades.solves: Chaos swarm attrition wears steel out across a deep run; runtime-verified diamond-class durability (greatsword class 2400 vs steel 1200) keeps a weapon alive through the longest planned fights.
upgrades.doesNotSolve: Still a melee commitment against armored bone imps with no reach or crowd answer; it does not help during the termite ambush window or replace coordinated target calls.
evidence: M0-recipe-equipment-audit.md: runtime durability log (diamond greatsword 2400 vs steel 1200)

inputs: overgeared:heated_netherite_alloy x1 (4 netherite_scrap + 4 gold_ingot via overgeared nether-alloy smelting; master forging minigame)
minecraft:netherite_upgrade_smithing_template x1 (vanilla bastion chests — pack overlay unverified) for the armor upgrade itself
upgrades.solves: Ancient debris plus banked middle gold becomes netherite — the survivability ceiling for a coordinated deepest push and the material prerequisite of the dark-metal armor chain.
upgrades.doesNotSolve: The master forging minigame, the bastion template hunt, and the blocked dark-metal inputs keep this expensive and partial; it does not reach the pack's dark_metal_armor tier on its own (see blocked nodes).

blocked.neededFor: born_in_chaos_v1:diamond_thermite_shard_k (9 shards -> minecraft:diamond): the verified combat-funded diamond route for teams short on vein luck
blocked.reason: A termite only spawns when a player breaks born_in_chaos_v1 infected diamond ore, and the M2c/M3 ore planner places resource-kind catalog entries only — encounter-kind infected ores are catalogued and registry-verified but never placed in the configured mine. The summon procedure, shard loot table, and recipe are artifact-verified, yet the repeatable in-mine source does not exist today. Recorded as a gap; the placement decision belongs to M8 encounter/content work rather than a fabricated reward here.
evidence: M0-native-loot-smoke.md + M4a-encounter-validation.md (procedure and shard drop verified on a placed block)

blocked.reason: Verified pack sources (nightmare_stalker, dread_hound, dire_hound_leader entity tables) are not in the configured mine encounter profile, which currently schedules only decrepit_skeleton and bone_imp. Dark metal armor is unreachable from configured mine content; M8 encounter decisions must unblock or redesign it. Not fabricated as a mine reward.

blocked.neededFor: born_in_chaos_v1:armor_plate_from_dark_metal_k_2..5 (dark metal armor smithing onto netherite pieces)
blocked.reason: Only verified pack source is born_in_chaos_v1:fallen_chaos_knight (weight 5 drop) or Born in Chaos structure chests; the knight is not a configured mine encounter, so the deepest armor tier is blocked upstream of monster_skin as well.

discovery: Spawn-side guidance: /dawnmine help and /dawnmine status point players at the shared run; this graph's upgrade list is exposed read-only to players via /dawnmine progression.
In-world signals: ore catalog minimum tools make harvest gates readable at the block; encounter composition threat/counterplay text is logged server-side and surfaced in admin/status output.
Recipe discovery rides the pack's own recipe book/JEI — no custom items were added, so nothing outside pack-native discovery is required.

Banked-material persistence is player inventory plus the Foreman's Dispatch locker (M5b, landed); the audit's verified persistent store is an ordinary surface chest, which models the same player-owned, outside-run-state guarantee.
